Step back into the abandoned cathedral with Blood & Shadow 2, a dark arts continuation by Nolimit City. The Shadow girl returns to a dynamic 5x5 reel configuration that features a locked bottom row and expands from 1024 up to 3125 ways to win. The core gameplay revolves around the Ritual Bar located beneath the main grid. Landing scatter symbols or scoring wins with medium and high paying symbols advances this meter through five distinct levels. Each progression removes lower tier symbols, upgrades medium symbols, and unlocks sticky wild symbols on the bottom row. You will also encounter the **xSplit** mechanic, appearing as either a Dagger that divides its own row or a Guillotine that divides everything below it. These symbols always carry a multiplier and transform into wilds after splitting. Players can also utilize the **xBet** options to guarantee specific symbol drops or increase the likelihood of triggering the main features.

Reaching the fifth and final level triggers Reign of Terror Spins. During this ultimate phase, the progression meter is removed entirely, and the grid is populated exclusively by high paying symbols while wild symbols become sticky at the bottom of the screen. features.name: Reel Area
features.description:
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description:
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

features.name: Candle Spins
features.description:
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

During Candle Spins, the Ritual Bar performs same as in base game.

features.name: Sticky Wild
features.description:
Sticky Wild can land on any reel.

Candle Spins & Reign of Terror Spins: The Wild drops down to the bottom of the reel and becomes Sticky Wild, until it is part of the winning combination or a new bet is made.

features.name: xSplit®
features.description:
There are 2 types of xSplit® symbols:-

- Dagger xSplit®: Splits it’s row.
- Guillotine xSplit®: Splits all symbols below it on its reel.

×Split® will always appear with x2 multiplier on it. Symbols that are split by xSplit® also get their multiplier values respectively. Both Dagger and Guillotine will turn to a Wild after the split. Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

Maximum symbol size can be 32x.

features.name: Halifax Gibbet Spins
features.description:
Buying Halifax Gibbet Spins instantly progresses the Ritual bar to level 3 and awards +6 Candle Spins.

3 of the low and medium paying symbols are replaced with 3 high paying symbols.

features.name: Reign of Terror Spins
features.description:
+6 Free Spins are awarded when entering Reign of Terror Spins.

Any potential wins has to be completed before entering Reign of Terror Spins.

The Ritual Bar is removed and the reel area becomes a 5x5 reel with only high paying symbols.

Landing a Scatter symbol gives a +1 spin.

Buying Reign of Terror Spins awards you 10 Free Spins

features.name: xBet (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 2.5 times the base bet, 3 times more likely to trigger Reign of Terror Spins. The Ritual Bar always starts at level 1.

features.name: xBet 2 (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 66 times the base bet, player is guaranteed a spin at Level 5 with Dagger and Guillotine symbols.

features.name: Enlightenment
features.description:
The max payout of the game is 16,161 times the base bet.

When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 16,161 times the base bet is awarded.

features.name: Reel Area
features.description:
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description:
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

features.name: Candle Spins
features.description:
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

During Candle Spins, the Ritual Bar performs same as in base game.

features.name: Sticky Wild
features.description:
Sticky Wild can land on any reel.

Candle Spins & Reign of Terror Spins: The Wild drops down to the bottom of the reel and becomes Sticky Wild, until it is part of the winning combination or a new bet is made.

features.name: xSplit®
features.description:
There are 2 types of xSplit® symbols:-

- Dagger xSplit®: Splits it’s row.
- Guillotine xSplit®: Splits all symbols below it on its reel.

×Split® will always appear with x2 multiplier on it. Symbols that are split by xSplit® also get their multiplier values respectively. Both Dagger and Guillotine will turn to a Wild after the split. Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

Maximum symbol size can be 32x.

features.name: Halifax Gibbet Spins
features.description:
Buying Halifax Gibbet Spins instantly progresses the Ritual bar to level 3 and awards +6 Candle Spins.

3 of the low and medium paying symbols are replaced with 3 high paying symbols.

features.name: Reign of Terror Spins
features.description:
+6 Free Spins are awarded when entering Reign of Terror Spins.

Any potential wins has to be completed before entering Reign of Terror Spins.

The Ritual Bar is removed and the reel area becomes a 5x5 reel with only high paying symbols.

Landing a Scatter symbol gives a +1 spin.

Buying Reign of Terror Spins awards you 10 Free Spins

features.name: xBet (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 2.5 times the base bet, 3 times more likely to trigger Reign of Terror Spins. The Ritual Bar always starts at level 1.

features.name: xBet 2 (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 66 times the base bet, player is guaranteed a spin at Level 5 with Dagger and Guillotine symbols.

features.name: Enlightenment
features.description:
The max payout of the game is 16,161 times the base bet.

When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 16,161 times the base bet is awarded.

features.name: Reel Area
features.description:
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description:
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

features.name: Candle Spins
features.description:
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

During Candle Spins, the Ritual Bar performs same as in base game.

features.name: Sticky Wild
features.description:
Sticky Wild can land on any reel.

Candle Spins & Reign of Terror Spins: The Wild drops down to the bottom of the reel and becomes Sticky Wild, until it is part of the winning combination or a new bet is made.

features.name: xSplit®
features.description:
There are 2 types of xSplit® symbols:-

- Dagger xSplit®: Splits it’s row.
- Guillotine xSplit®: Splits all symbols below it on its reel.

×Split® will always appear with x2 multiplier on it. Symbols that are split by xSplit® also get their multiplier values respectively. Both Dagger and Guillotine will turn to a Wild after the split. Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

Maximum symbol size can be 32x.

features.name: Halifax Gibbet Spins
features.description:
Buying Halifax Gibbet Spins instantly progresses the Ritual bar to level 3 and awards +6 Candle Spins.

3 of the low and medium paying symbols are replaced with 3 high paying symbols.

features.name: Reign of Terror Spins
features.description:
+6 Free Spins are awarded when entering Reign of Terror Spins.

Any potential wins has to be completed before entering Reign of Terror Spins.

The Ritual Bar is removed and the reel area becomes a 5x5 reel with only high paying symbols.

Landing a Scatter symbol gives a +1 spin.

Buying Reign of Terror Spins awards you 10 Free Spins

xMechanics.name: xBet®
xMechanics.description: At an extra cost per spin, the player gets an increased chance of getting into the Bonus Modes. The way this happens varies from game to game. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

xMechanics.name: xSplit®
xMechanics.description: xSplit® was first made available within xWays Hoarder xSplit, released in July 2021. On this first occasion, xSplit symbols go a long way towards assisting wins through the feature, as any xSplit symbols in view to the right of a Scatter symbol will turn the Scatter into a Super Scatter symbol – which within this release assists in progressing the feature through several levels. However, aside from the progression through bonus levels, xSplit as individual symbols increase win ways during base play. features.name: Reel Area
features.description:
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description:
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

features.name: Candle Spins
features.description:
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

During Candle Spins, the Ritual Bar performs same as in base game.

features.name: Sticky Wild
features.description:
Sticky Wild can land on any reel.

Candle Spins & Reign of Terror Spins: The Wild drops down to the bottom of the reel and becomes Sticky Wild, until it is part of the winning combination or a new bet is made.

features.name: xSplit®
features.description:
There are 2 types of xSplit® symbols:-

- Dagger xSplit®: Splits it’s row.
- Guillotine xSplit®: Splits all symbols below it on its reel.

×Split® will always appear with x2 multiplier on it. Symbols that are split by xSplit® also get their multiplier values respectively. Both Dagger and Guillotine will turn to a Wild after the split. Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

Maximum symbol size can be 32x.

features.name: Halifax Gibbet Spins
features.description:
Buying Halifax Gibbet Spins instantly progresses the Ritual bar to level 3 and awards +6 Candle Spins.

3 of the low and medium paying symbols are replaced with 3 high paying symbols.

features.name: Reign of Terror Spins
features.description:
+6 Free Spins are awarded when entering Reign of Terror Spins.

Any potential wins has to be completed before entering Reign of Terror Spins.

The Ritual Bar is removed and the reel area becomes a 5x5 reel with only high paying symbols.

Landing a Scatter symbol gives a +1 spin.

Buying Reign of Terror Spins awards you 10 Free Spins

features.name: xBet (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 2.5 times the base bet, 3 times more likely to trigger Reign of Terror Spins. The Ritual Bar always starts at level 1.

features.name: xBet 2 (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 66 times the base bet, player is guaranteed a spin at Level 5 with Dagger and Guillotine symbols.

features.name: Enlightenment
features.description:
The max payout of the game is 16,161 times the base bet.

When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 16,161 times the base bet is awarded.

features.name: Nolimit Bonus Buy
features.description: Buy your way straight into the different bonus features, ranging from 100 to 500 times the base bet.
features.disclaimer: The Nolimit Bonus feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

features.name: Nolimit Booster
features.description: Buy a specific game feature in the Nolimit Bonus tool. The total cost for the activated feature will be charged from your balance for each spin.
features.disclaimer: The Nolimit Booster feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

features.name: Action Spins

Get your adrenaline flowing and play your regular bonus rounds in HYPER MODE!

‘Action Spins’ is a new optional feature that ushers in an innovative way to play a high volume of rounds of the Base Game or Multiple Bonus rounds in a rapid and exhilarating way!

features.name: Reel Area
features.description:
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description:
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

features.name: Candle Spins
features.description:
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

During Candle Spins, the Ritual Bar performs same as in base game.

features.name: Sticky Wild
features.description:
Sticky Wild can land on any reel.

Candle Spins & Reign of Terror Spins: The Wild drops down to the bottom of the reel and becomes Sticky Wild, until it is part of the winning combination or a new bet is made.

features.name: xSplit®
features.description:
There are 2 types of xSplit® symbols:-

- Dagger xSplit®: Splits it’s row.
- Guillotine xSplit®: Splits all symbols below it on its reel.

×Split® will always appear with x2 multiplier on it. Symbols that are split by xSplit® also get their multiplier values respectively. Both Dagger and Guillotine will turn to a Wild after the split. Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

Maximum symbol size can be 32x.

features.name: Halifax Gibbet Spins
features.description:
Buying Halifax Gibbet Spins instantly progresses the Ritual bar to level 3 and awards +6 Candle Spins.

3 of the low and medium paying symbols are replaced with 3 high paying symbols.

features.name: Reign of Terror Spins
features.description:
+6 Free Spins are awarded when entering Reign of Terror Spins.

Any potential wins has to be completed before entering Reign of Terror Spins.

The Ritual Bar is removed and the reel area becomes a 5x5 reel with only high paying symbols.

Landing a Scatter symbol gives a +1 spin.

Buying Reign of Terror Spins awards you 10 Free Spins

features.name: xBet (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 2.5 times the base bet, 3 times more likely to trigger Reign of Terror Spins. The Ritual Bar always starts at level 1.

features.name: xBet 2 (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 66 times the base bet, player is guaranteed a spin at Level 5 with Dagger and Guillotine symbols.

features.name: Enlightenment
features.description:
The max payout of the game is 16,161 times the base bet.

When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 16,161 times the base bet is awarded.

features.name: Reel Area
features.description:
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

features.name: Ritual Bar
features.description:
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

features.name: Candle Spins
features.description:
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

During Candle Spins, the Ritual Bar performs same as in base game.

features.name: Sticky Wild
features.description:
Sticky Wild can land on any reel.

Candle Spins & Reign of Terror Spins: The Wild drops down to the bottom of the reel and becomes Sticky Wild, until it is part of the winning combination or a new bet is made.

features.name: xSplit®
features.description:
There are 2 types of xSplit® symbols:-

- Dagger xSplit®: Splits it’s row.
- Guillotine xSplit®: Splits all symbols below it on its reel.

×Split® will always appear with x2 multiplier on it. Symbols that are split by xSplit® also get their multiplier values respectively. Both Dagger and Guillotine will turn to a Wild after the split. Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

Maximum symbol size can be 32x.

features.name: Halifax Gibbet Spins
features.description:
Buying Halifax Gibbet Spins instantly progresses the Ritual bar to level 3 and awards +6 Candle Spins.

3 of the low and medium paying symbols are replaced with 3 high paying symbols.

features.name: Reign of Terror Spins
features.description:
+6 Free Spins are awarded when entering Reign of Terror Spins.

Any potential wins has to be completed before entering Reign of Terror Spins.

The Ritual Bar is removed and the reel area becomes a 5x5 reel with only high paying symbols.

Landing a Scatter symbol gives a +1 spin.

Buying Reign of Terror Spins awards you 10 Free Spins

features.name: xBet (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 2.5 times the base bet, 3 times more likely to trigger Reign of Terror Spins. The Ritual Bar always starts at level 1.

features.name: xBet 2 (Nolimit Booster)
features.description: At a cost of 66 times the base bet, player is guaranteed a spin at Level 5 with Dagger and Guillotine symbols.

features.name: Enlightenment
features.description:
The max payout of the game is 16,161 times the base bet.

When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 16,161 times the base bet is awarded.

features.description: Buy your way straight into the different bonus features, ranging from 100 to 500 times the base bet.
